challenge.title: A Shopping Trip in the Medina
challenge.instructions: Write and act a shopping conversation of at least 10 lines. It must include asking for an item by size, discussing a color choice, checking the price, bargaining at least once, and a return or exchange with the receipt mentioned. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 6 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: An opening request using بغيت and a clothing item.
A size question using أشمن مقاس كتلبس؟ or أشمن مقاس كتلبسي؟
At least one bargaining line using واش تقدر تنقص ليا من الثمن؟ or نقص ليا شوية.
A final price line using آخر ثمن.
A return or exchange line using نرجع or نبدلها.
A mention of the receipt using الفاتورة.
A closing thank-you or blessing such as الله يعطيك الصحة.

dialogue.speaker: Youssef
dialogue.english: Hello, I want a shirt please.

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss
dialogue.english: Hello, what size do you wear?

dialogue.speaker: Youssef
dialogue.arabic: كنلبس لارج، وعجبني اللون الزرق. بشحال هادي؟
dialogue.transliteration: kanlbes laarj, w 3jebni l-lon z-zreq. bsh7aal haadi?
dialogue.english: I wear large, and I like the blue color. How much is this?

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss
dialogue.english: A hundred and fifty dirhams.

dialogue.speaker: Youssef
dialogue.arabic: غالية بزاف، واش تقدر تنقص ليا من الثمن؟
dialogue.transliteration: ghaalya bzzaf, waash tqder tnqqeS liya men t-taman?
dialogue.english: Very expensive, can you lower the price?

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss

dialogue.transliteration: n3Tiik liha b-mya u 3shriin, haada aakhir taman.
dialogue.english: I'll give it to you for a hundred and twenty, this is the final price.

dialogue.speaker: Youssef
dialogue.english: Ok, we agreed.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.arabic: (من بعد جوج أيام) السلام عليكم، بغيت نرجع هاد القميجة، هادا ماشي المقاس ديالي.

dialogue.english: (two days later) Hello, I want to return this shirt, this isn't my size.

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss
dialogue.english: Welcome, do you have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: Yes, I have the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss
dialogue.english: Do you want to return it or exchange it?

dialogue.speaker: Hajj Driss
dialogue.english: Sure, wait a moment and I'll see.

dialogue.speaker: Salma
dialogue.english: Thank you very much, bless you.
